text: Fifteen clinics, fifteen legacy billing systems, one CSV dropped into cloud storage every night. This video builds the very first layer of Harborview's new lakehouse: Auto Loader landing those files into Bronze.
Bronze has exactly three jobs: discover new files incrementally, track the schema so a clinic adding a column doesn't break anything, and write append-only with zero business logic.
cloudFiles.format is csv, schemaLocation persists what Auto Loader infers, and schemaEvolutionMode addNewColumns means a new field just shows up -- it never halts the stream.
Every row gets a _file_name and an _ingested_at column before it lands in harborview.bronze.claims_raw, append-only, so any claim can be traced back to the exact file it came from.
Bronze is live and faithful to the source. Next: the Lakeflow Declarative Pipeline that actually cleans this data -- and a data-quality decision that matters more than it looks.
